en.title: Reuse a cold atlas across overlapping WebGPU draws
en.body: Two consecutive direct frames can sample the same immutable page as soon as its upload and first draw have been submitted. The Host retains the page until the borrowing draw retires and starts with a fresh upload after device loss.

zh.title: WebGPU 连续绘制可复用首次上传的图集
zh.body: 不可变图集上传并成功提交首帧后，相邻的直接绘制可复用同一张纹理。Host 持有页面直到借用帧释放，设备丢失后在新设备上重新上传。
